description: This file defines the Calendar class for SuiteCRM, containing properties and methods for handling calendar views, loading activities, calculating date ranges, and navigation within the calendar. It includes logic for different calendar views, user preferences, and activity data management.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing calendar views, loading activities, date calculations, and user preferences within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Calendar object, setting the view, date, user preferences, and calendar settings based on request parameters and user configurations.

methods.name: load_activities
methods.description: Loads activities data into the calendar, fetching from CalendarActivity and mapping fields for display.

methods.name: init_shared
methods.description: Initializes shared user IDs for collaborative calendar access based on user preferences or request parameters.

methods.name: calculate_grid_start_ts
methods.description: Calculates the starting timestamp of the calendar grid depending on the current view.

methods.name: calculate_day_range
methods.description: Determines the number of slots per day and calculates start/end times based on user working hours.

methods.name: add_activities
methods.description: Fetches activities for a specific user within a date range, considering the calendar view.

methods.name: get_neighbor_date_str
methods.description: Generates the date string for the previous or next calendar view period.

methods.name: setPrint
methods.description: Sets whether the calendar should be rendered in print mode.

methods.name: isPrint
methods.description: Checks if the calendar is in print mode.
